parrafo_1.es: En Uderma Medspa & Laser, Alana lidera las inyecciones de labios con un toque delicado: clientas vuelven una y otra vez, y muchas traen a sus amigas. El equipo de recepción es parte del motivo: atento, profesional y siempre dispuesto a acomodar horarios.
parrafo_1.en: At Uderma Medspa & Laser, Alana leads lip injections with a gentle touch: clients come back again and again, and many bring their friends along. The front desk team is part of the reason why: attentive, professional and always willing to work around your schedule.

parrafo_2.es: El espacio combina una amplia gama de tratamientos con tecnología actual, desde láser BBL hasta EMFACE, en un ambiente impecable que las clientas describen como limpio y acogedor.
parrafo_2.en: The space pairs a wide range of treatments with current technology, from BBL laser to EMFACE, inside a spotless setting clients describe as clean and welcoming.

items.quote: Alana is a great injector! I’ve been 3 times to get my lips done and have brought friends with me 4 times since and everyone is always happy. The receptionist is also very helpful.

Exceptional service! They’re always accommodating and offer a wide range of treatment options using the latest technology. I’ve had a great experience every time and keep coming back. Highly recommend!

The receptionist was very welcoming and professional, and Alana was absolutely amazing! She was so funny and made me feel comfortable the entire time. I was very relaxed that I hardly felt a thing! My lips turned out absolutely beautiful, and I couldn’t be happier with my results. I definitely recommend Alana to anyone considering lip filler.
